audience: field-service teams in trades that plan jobs, crews and time in Artesa

useCases.title: Plan the work steps of next week
useCases.text: List the work steps of a time window, then list the gangs and users to see which crew is on each job.

useCases.title: Review the jobs of one customer
useCases.text: Find the customer, then list the assignments with their project, type and status. Open one assignment to read its details.

useCases.title: Check staff absences and time sheets
useCases.text: List the absences of users in a time window, and the weekly time sheets with their status, before you plan staffing.

useCases.title: Look up projects and status types
useCases.text: List the projects that group assignments, open one project, and list the assignment status types your company uses.

useCases.title: Create a customer for a new client
useCases.text: Create a customer record for a company or a private person, then read it back. A retry creates a second record, so check the list first.
